Nine payments are due in the next four weeks, and one more has no due date. Ordnung lists these:

- Reminder from TechMarkt Online GmbH, due Wed 30 Sep 2026 (send by Tue 29 Sep 2026): 94.99 € [item:itm_c05nsrmyz6av]. If it isn't paid, the claim may be handed to a debt collection service.

- Deutschlandticket, due Thu 1 Oct 2026: 63.00 €. It is a direct debit [item:itm_2s90qr4prp13].
- Parking warning fee to the city, due Fri 2 Oct 2026: 30.00 €. Ordnung has not verified this amount, so please check it against the paper letter [item:itm_w1ny8kz9kmwt].

- Additional service charges for 2025 (Nachzahlung) to the landlord, due Fri 9 Oct 2026: 184.30 € [item:itm_dmaw27qvv18n].
- Extension fee at the Ausländerbehörde, due Wed 14 Oct 2026: 100.00 €. It must be paid on site by girocard, because cash is not possible [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m].
- Health and care insurance (Muster BKK), due Thu 15 Oct 2026: 156.55 €. It is a direct debit [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe].

**No due date stored:** Ordnung has no due date for the library's overdue fees of 4.50 €. They are paid when you return the items [item:itm_kgsfgwac9wzx].

**Do not pay yet:** A demand for broadcasting fee arrears of 254.35 € shows scam signs. It has hidden text, a 48-hour deadline, and a different bank account from the one used before. A genuine sender whose bank details changed would show the same signs [item:itm_ngh7a5vr7x4j].
